name: incomplete-assessment
why: Two questions left unanswered and everything else Yes. An expected question with no answer scores nothing and stays in the denominator, so the running total reads 96% rather than 100% — a half-finished assessment reads as half-finished rather than as a high score over a small sample, and the figure climbs towards the real one as the visit proceeds. Not applicable is still excluded from both sides, because that is the assessor saying the question does not apply and silence is not that statement. The two questions are still reported missing and is_complete is still false: the submission endpoint refuses on that, never on the percentage looking implausible.
